title: Serum β-synuclein predicts dementia conversion and mortality beyond amyloid-β and phospho-tau
title_zh: 血清β-突触蛋白预测阿尔茨海默病进展与死亡率，超越β-淀粉样蛋白与磷酸化tau
abstract: Abstract Synaptic dysfunction is among the earliest pathological events in Alzheimer's disease and among the strongest neuropathological correlates of cognitive impairment, yet blood-based synaptic biomarkers are lacking. Whether serum β-synuclein provides prognostic information independent of established amyloid-β (A; CSF Aβ42/Aβ40 ratio) and tau (T1; CSF pTau181) biomarkers has not been determined. We studied 259 non-demented individuals with subjective or mild cognitive impairment from a single-centre memory clinic, classified by CSF biomarkers using externally validated cut-offs into A−T1− controls (n = 97), A−T1+ PASSED (‘pTau and Aβ surge with subtle deterioration’, n = 65), and A + T1+ Alzheimer's disease (n = 97), with parallel analyses using Aβ40-normalised pTau181. Endpoints comprised dementia conversion (n = 185, median follow-up 4.1 years), all-cause mortality (n = 258, median 7.0 years), longitudinal MMSE trajectories (n = 185), and regional brain volumes (n = 137). Independence from CSF biomarkers was quantified through systematic effect attenuation analysis. Serum β-synuclein was selectively elevated in the Alzheimer's disease group (Cohen's d = 0.69 vs controls, P < 0.001) but not in PASSED individuals (P = 0.40), and was more strongly associated with CSF pTau181 (r = 0.36) than with the Aβ42/Aβ40 ratio (r = −0.20) across the cohort. Each standard deviation increase was associated with higher risk of dementia conversion (hazard ratio (HR) = 1.40; 95% CI: 1.11, 1.77; P = 0.005), faster cognitive decline (−0.11 SD/year, 95% CI: −0.18, −0.04, P = 0.002, corresponding to −0.20 MMSE points/year), and higher mortality (HR = 1.33; 95% CI: 1.07, 1.65; P = 0.010). For dementia conversion and mortality, adjustment for continuous CSF pTau181 and Aβ42/Aβ40 produced minimal attenuation (≤13%). Both associations were preserved under Aβ40-normalised T1 staging but not against continuous pTau181 normalised to CSF Aβ40. For cognitive decline, β-synuclein's effect remained significant after Aβ42/Aβ40 adjustment (25% attenuation; P = 0.007) but was substantially attenuated by pTau181 (58.5%; P = 0.186). Serum β-synuclein was associated with lower bilateral temporal lobe volume—the only lobar regions to survive hierarchical testing—with sub-regional involvement spanning the hippocampi, entorhinal cortex and parahippocampal gyrus, and explained 5.0–8.9% of unique variance beyond CSF biomarkers. Plasma glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) showed a strong association with β-synuclein, estimated in the PASSED subgroup (β=0.34 per SD, P < 0.001). Serum β-synuclein provided prognostic information largely independent of CSF Aβ42/Aβ40 across all endpoints and of pTau181 for survival outcomes, while sharing substantial prognostic variance with pTau181 for cognitive trajectory, supporting its candidacy as a blood-based synaptic complement to core Alzheimer's disease biomarkers.
abstract_zh: 摘要 突触功能障碍是阿尔茨海默病最早的病理事件之一，也是认知障碍最强的神经病理学相关因素，但血液突触生物标志物尚缺乏。血清β-突触蛋白是否能在已知的β-淀粉样蛋白（A；脑脊液Aβ42/Aβ40比值）和tau（T1；脑脊液pTau181）生物标志物之外提供预后信息尚未确定。我们在单中心记忆门诊中研究了259名无痴呆或主观/轻度认知障碍个体，依据外部验证的阈值将脑脊液生物标志物分为A−T1−对照组（n=97）、A−T1+ PASSED组（“pTau与Aβ升高伴随细微恶化”，n=65）和A+T1+阿尔茨海默病组（n=97），并使用Aβ40标准化的pTau181进行并行分析。终点包括痴呆转化（n=185，随访中位数4.1年）、全因死亡率（n=258，随访中位数7.0年）、纵向MMSE轨迹（n=185）以及区域脑容积（n=137）。通过系统效应衰减分析量化与脑脊液生物标志物的独立性。血清β-突触蛋白在阿尔茨海默病组中显著升高（Cohen's d=0.69 vs 对照，P<0.001），但在PASSED个体中未升高（P=0.40），且与脑脊液pTau181的相关性（r=0.36）强于与Aβ42/Aβ40比值（r=-0.20）。每标准差增加与痴呆转化风险升高相关（风险比HR=1.40；95% CI:1.11,1.77；P=0.005），认知下降加速（-0.11 SD/年，95% CI:-0.18,-0.04，P=0.002，对应-0.20 MMSE点/年）以及死亡率升高（HR=1.33；95% CI:1.07,1.65；P=0.010）。对于痴呆转化和死亡率，调整连续脑脊液pTau181和Aβ42/Aβ40后，效应衰减最小（≤13%）。两种关联在Aβ40标准化的T1分期下保持，但在以脑脊液Aβ40标准化的连续pTau181下不再显著。对于认知下降，β-突触蛋白在调整Aβ42/Aβ40后仍显著（衰减25%；P=0.007），但在pTau181调整后显著衰减（58.5%；P=0.186）。血清β-突触蛋白与双侧颞叶体积降低相关——这是唯一在层级检验中存活的叶区，涉及海马、嗅旁皮层和海马旁回，解释了5.0–8.9%的独特方差，超出脑脊液生物标志物。血浆胶质纤维酸性蛋白（GFAP）与β-突触蛋白呈强相关，在PASSED亚组中估计为β=0.34每SD，P<0.001。血清β-突触蛋白在所有终点上提供的预后信息在很大程度上独立于脑脊液Aβ42/Aβ40，并在生存结果中独立于pTau181，同时与pTau181在认知轨迹上共享大量预后方差，支持其作为血液突触补充核心阿尔茨海默病生物标志物的候选者。
